materialChanges: Made the two-mean worked, practice, chart, mastery, glossary, claim, and attribution records consistently identify the retained 1.96-based procedure as a normal approximation, with z notation and the pooled t(58) result presented only as a declared alternative.

Named the transfer calculation as an unpooled Wald normal approximation, showed the formula and consistent test-and-interval use, disclosed the sparse-count limitation, and added a mapped NIST reference and rights record.

Changed item-compute-statistic to a single-choice response that can collect both the population null statement and the computed statistic, aligned its answer and rubric, and strengthened the worked example's self-explanation prompt around the two-sided design decision.

Removed unsupported clinical-importance and individual-variability thresholds, replaced them with a neutral statement of the interval's range, and removed the practice recommendation from the closing minute.

reviewDispositions.rationale: item-compute-statistic is now a single-choice item whose options jointly state the null and compute z; the correct response, reasoning, acceptable response, common errors, two-point rubric, and response specification now collect and score the same evidence.

The self-explanation prompt now asks why the one-tail area is doubled and which two-sided hypothesis choice makes both tails count, requiring explanation of the design decision that determines the reported probability.

This note records a successful first-read observation rather than a defect. The final revision preserves the opening's concrete meeting, plain-language register, and learner-facing boundary without restyling it.

This note records that the faded practice and cross-context transfer structure already met the standard. The revision preserves that progression; the transfer edit only makes its statistical method and limitation explicit.

The retained canonical values are now one coherent normal-approximation procedure: the statistic is z = 2.18, the p-value uses the standard normal tails, and the interval uses 1.96. The chart, practice, mastery stimuli, glossary, claims, and attribution state that convention; t(58) = about 0.033 is clearly separated as an alternative procedure.

Scene 7 now names and displays the unpooled Wald normal approximation, states that both proportions and their variance are estimated, uses the same standard error for z and the interval, warns that five events make coverage fragile, and maps the method and limitation to a new NIST reference.

The same assessment repair described for learning-design finding 0 resolves this duplicate academic finding: one response now supplies both required pieces of evidence and every scoring field agrees with that response.

Scene 9 no longer judges 17.1 mg/dL worth a service or 0.9 mg/dL invisible or swamped. It neutrally states the nearly twenty-fold range, defers clinical importance and variability judgments, and says the hypothesis-testing analysis alone cannot determine a practice change.

evidenceChecked: All nine scenes retain one level-one heading, logical Markdown source order, ordinary headings, lists, tables, and inert declarative directives; no raw HTML tags, HTML entities, scripts, remote embeds, or executable content were introduced.

The quantitative chart retains an alt text, outcome-equivalent long description, labelled axes, markers, shaded-region labels, and source data; the revision makes its normal-approximation status explicit without relying on colour or position alone.

Important equations are accompanied by prose that defines the quantities, units, assumptions, reference curve, and interpretation; the transfer formula has a complete text route and no learning operation depends on seeing the layout.

Assessment remains untimed and retakeable with after-attempt feedback and non-drag single-choice operation; prompts, answer logic, feedback, remediation, and acceptable responses remain in semantic JSON strings.

All clinical studies, audits, participants, and counts are labelled invented; no personal, patient, learner, credential, secret, or identifying data is present, and the medical-advice boundaries remain explicit.

The lesson remains CC BY 4.0 with no third-party assets. Every source use is factual-reference under original expression, all agent-access statuses are checked-no-agent-restriction-found, and no human-only source was processed.

The added NIST record identifies the exact page, formula and limitation used, dates access, records the published public-information basis and agent-access check, and the attribution file distinguishes the original audit from the factual method reference.
Author provenance, accountable principal, instruction digest, fresh finalizer provenance in this artifact, and the frozen review artifacts remain disclosed; no review file was edited.
limitations: No rendered browser, assistive-technology, keyboard-only, 200 per cent zoom, narrow-viewport, reduced-motion, print, or non-web export test was run; this audit is based on the canonical source and structured alternatives.

Per the operator's scope, site schemas and quorum files were not opened and npm validation or source preflight was not run. JSON parsing, identity invariants, allowed source types and field limits, answer-string types, claim/source links, raw-HTML checks, and frozen-review immutability were checked locally.
The NIST access conclusion is based on its published use policy and site-privacy notice; a robots response was not independently retrieved.
GitHub COMMENTED transport equivalence was supplied by the accountable operator and was not independently queried in this run. Provenance is disclosed and attested, not platform-verified.

rationale: The exact original candidate and both eligible advisory reviews were read in full. The standard review-input gate is satisfied by one academic and one learning-design record against the same candidate across two distinct declared runs, providers, and model families; both requested changes and neither is represented as approving the final edit. Every indexed finding is disposed, all four substantive defects were resolved in one coherent revision, the resulting calculations and assessment logic agree, and the final accessibility-and-rights audit found no unresolved blocker. The merge decision is therefore supported subject to the operator-only commit/provenance substitution and required repository validation recorded below.
dissent: Both advisory reviews recorded request-changes verdicts against the original candidate. Their substantive objections were incorporated, but neither reviewer inspected or approved the final revision.
